body:
AUTHORIZED continuation of Myk's 2026-09-05 autonomous receiving-policy work. T281 source and immutable rail snapshot exist at 7a0bfc2. Extend the internal reference proof, with no production wiring or package export, to exact one-time law selections and paused-live selection restrictions. Existing T281 rails remain unchanged. Reuse one projection infrastructure and existing source lawful-resolution primitives; do not duplicate a new federation or negation engine.

DURABLE INPUT. Extend the experimental receiver-signed decision profile narrowly. A one-time binding carries selection {source, registrationId, memberIds, versionId}; its source identity must match the binding. A pause record targets an exact surviving live binding delta ID and carries that selection or null for no selected law. Resume is lawful receiver negation of that pause. Selection commits the exact normalized verified member set using freezeMembers' version address. Require all declared members, no duplicate member IDs, matching address and matching selected registration ID/entity/reading/source author. Whole-source snapshots are acceptable bounded operands; the caller authenticates source membership/completeness. Hash verification proves declared members, not undisclosed source completeness. Missing/invalid selections refuse explicitly. Incompatible surviving pauses refuse deterministically, and a valid curse still prevents serving. One-time without a selection retains existing unsupported refusal.

PROJECTION. One-time resolves only the committed members and ignores subsequent source additions/retractions from other inputs. Paused live resolves those exact members plus received forward negation closure; new source registrations/definitions cannot enter. Require the pinned registration and law definition selection to remain eligible; never fall back to another registration or definition if a pinned member is withdrawn. A lawful strike-of-strike can restore it. Pausing with null remains without selected law until resume. Resume follows current held eligible source law without fetching or signing. In all modes, receiver curses/binding withdrawal apply and source bytes remain. Foreign recipient decisions and foreign strikes confer no authority. Returned candidates retain T281 resolver withholding, invalid roots refusal and unsupported nested-dependency refusal. Source identity/recipient authority/data scope remain explicit trusted caller boundaries. Executable code never loads.

ACCEPTANCE (all verified by npx vitest run test/gateway/receive-snapshot.test.ts together with unchanged T281 suites):
1. Live and one-time select M1; held M2 changes only live. Assert exact bound IDs AND real resolved values. New relevant destination facts affect both readings without changing one-time law.
2. A paused live selection remains M1 after a late backdated registration and a replacement hyperschema definition; verify gather program identity, not only resolution-schema metadata. Replayed permutations/duplicates agree.
3. A lawful strike of pinned registration OR pinned hyperschema definition makes paused-live unavailable and never substitutes older surviving law. One-time remains fixed. Strike-of-strike restores paused law; stranger strike does nothing.
4. Resume with M2 already held selects it without any new adoption claim or signer API. Empty pause remains empty and then resumes from held law.
5. Missing members, duplicate manifest IDs, wrong version address, wrong registration, source mismatch, pause bound to another relationship, and conflicting pauses refuse with named status. Include valid signed controls; every input is verified before deduplication.
6. Curse/lift affects every mode while preserving byte identities. Unsupported dependencies and resolver field withholding still hold. Source-only receiver-signed pause/binding claims never gain local authority.

RAILS FIRST. Author only the new test file first; measure meaningful failures against T281 baseline (module absence alone is not behavioral red), then declare and freeze the measured file before implementation. Record fixture defects and necessary rail corrections. No T281 rail edits. Run focused tests, scoped formatting/lint/full typecheck, full npm run check in isolated clone if user handoff still prevents workspace docs build, frozen-rail guard, meaningful scoped mutation checks and independent review. Keep exact test/hash evidence and honest limitations. This does not complete T280, T263 or PR557. No ambient Gateway, migration, export, alias lifecycle, nested registry or persistent snapshot-capture UI is in scope. The pure projector consumes a signed explicit manifest; production capture is a later adapter contract.

DEFINITION IDENTITY. Resolve the committed operand first and derive exact selected registration, hyperschema-definition and resolution-schema-definition delta IDs. Derive definition identities using substrate bootstrap rows over lawfulSnapshot and its descending timestamp / ascending delta-ID tie-break. Existing loadHyperSchema/loadSchema do not return IDs; exported HYPER_SCHEMA_SCHEMA and SCHEMA_SCHEMA expose the rows. For paused live, require these original selected IDs to remain lawful survivors after forward negation closure. Return the original selected metadata, never reload a fallback. Even identical-content definitions have distinct authority identities. Add cases with older/newer same-entity definitions, identical content but distinct IDs, and resolution-schema withdrawal. No redundant manifest definition-ID fields are needed: derive IDs from its committed operand.

ENTRY POINT. Retain T281 input compatibility and unchanged tests; a neutral internal projectReceiving entry point may share the implementation with the existing live-named proof entry point. Author rails against existing callable projection first to obtain behavioral failures for valid signed one-time/pause records. Do not mutate T281 frozen rails. Unsupported one-time records without selection remain unsupported. Unsupported nested shapes remain refused, rather than pretending to capture their dependency closure.

PAUSE TARGET LIFETIME. A pause applies only to its exact surviving live binding delta ID. After lawful withdrawal of that binding, its surviving pause must not constrain a replacement binding under the same relationship name. Test A withdrawn, B created, old pause retained: B follows held M2. A pause targeting the surviving binding but carrying mismatched relationship/reading remains invalid-selection. Keep resolver withholding controls on a distinct computed field; do not evaluate a withheld field through policy fallback to claim real served behavior.

RAIL MEASUREMENT: 18 cases executed against callable T281 baseline; 15 behavioral failures and 3 accepted controls. Log /tmp/t282-red.log. Before freeze corrected an unnamed schema fixture and moved withheld executable field away from the declarative field used for value assertions. Final authoring SHA256 9b5dc8402eb50dd96e6da5e696028059a9f53041ed74bbf23ed8c753cd9cebaf. No existing T281 rail changed.

AUTHORIZED RAIL CORRECTIONS: Independent P3 audit and independent verification found four nondiscriminating/missing controls: late revision timestamp5 lost to original10 even under a bad pause cutoff; fake missing member also corrupted address; foreign pause lift lacked a control; selected-law withdrawal lacked an unselected-lawful-member survivor. Findings recorded before repair. Corrected late revision to20 before pause30, committed an actual signed absent member under a valid address, asserted unauthorized pause lift leaves M1 with M2 held, and proved unselected older hyperschema/resolution definition strikes preserve M1. Corrected a TypeScript-only View narrowing fixture defect without changing value assertions. Before strengthening34focusedpassed; after36focusedpassed (20new+16T281). These are coverage corrections, not fabricated behavior-red/source-bug claims. T281 rails unchanged. Corrected T282 rail SHA25661506d9d46f51b39cc4038187b4cbbe6cf6b7b9a84246e9bd91ed63360d3237d.

MUTATION FOLLOW-UP: Added eight signed controls for short source identity and malformed manifests. Corrected duplicate member test to carry the valid duplicate-list address, so hash mismatch cannot mask failed duplicate rejection. Source unchanged throughout these coverage corrections. Final focused44tests pass; final rail SHA25605be3e164d039661da40a1b35305a4ecbde3157e77c76c3a7831baa9531bbb26. All six deliberate semantic mutations caused assertion failures: ignoring received retractions; one-time following retractions; withdrawing any member; using live rather than fixed operand; forgetting definition identities; and pause sticking to replacement binding. The generated versionId type-check omission is independently verified equivalent for signed JSON because exact hash equality still enforces the value. Preserve this defense-in-depth check, record its survivor honestly, and do not claim the strict hollow-test gate passed. Bounded correctness review accepts the code; full P5/P6 certification is not claimed.
title: Derive one-time imports and live pauses from exact law manifests
